# Open Bankruptcy Project - Redirecting to openbankruptcyproject.org
> Last updated: 2026-05-01

> Free educational resource at openbankruptcyproject.com.

## About
openbankruptcyproject.com is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.

## Key Pages
- Open Bankruptcy Project - Redirecting to openbankruptcyproject.org: https://openbankruptcyproject.com/
